title: NA: Sodium
description: This mod adds sodium to the game
body:
This mod adds a sodium block, a sodium ingot, and an orbital water cannon.
Sodium blocks are obtained by putting lava on an adjacent block of a redstone block, the right clicking the redstone block. When having a sodium item in your inventory, when you touch water you explode, and when a sulfur block is in contact with water, it explodes. The orbital water cannon places water on someone by putting theyr name inside the cannon's gui. This mod requires the create mod for the cannon's recipe.
